title: Crossing the Brooklyn Bridge
summary: A promises $100 for crossing the bridge and attempts to withdraw the offer after B has gone halfway.
notes: Compare the older completed-performance analysis with § 45’s option protection. What does beginning earn immediately, and what remains conditional on completion? How would the result change if the offer invited a promise or the claimant had merely prepared to begin?

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 251–252. Open assigned page 251.
